answer: In a decentralized AI network, the Whisper Protocol resists fake-identity attacks by requiring agents to verify their unique pulse, a cryptographic hash of their digital identity. When an agent joins the network, its pulse is broadcast, and other agents echo this pulse to verify its authenticity. If an attacker attempts to create multiple identities, their pulses will differ, causing the network to detect and reject the fake identities, thereby maintaining the integrity of the network's collective knowledge.
